description: Synthetic unresolvable-branch-amputate parity. Refusal messages come from the pinned blob. Plan results, fixture payload, and SessionEvent copies stay uncovered. No fixture diff is stored.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-canonical: planner.plan is not run. execute is not run. A missing canonical codec call is not a successful plan. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_conservative_default_blocks_salvage checks a fingerprint for three fixtures. One fixture inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_opt_in compares a plan dict for three recipes. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_fingerprint_differs_by_policy compares fingerprints. No fingerprint is hashed. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_dual_policy_plan_merge_attempt compares fingerprints. No fingerprint is hashed. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_loss_sums checks plan loss totals. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_empty_events_salvage_policy checks a fingerprint length. The empty-session apply refusal is a different test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_interacting_multi_fault_session plans two recipes. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications plans and then applies. No fingerprint is hashed and no fixture diff is stored. No output bytes are stored.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-session-copy: a kept SessionEvent copies in the pin. This crate stops on that value. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications uses SessionEvent records from the fixture. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_amputate_resolves_index_from_root_id uses SessionEvent records from the fixture.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-payload: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications carries payload on the events. This set does not store payload content. A payload-free result is not that test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_opt_in and tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_conservative_default_blocks_salvage load the same fixture. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_component_too_large carries payload. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_interacting_multi_fault_session carries payload. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_amputate_resolves_index_from_root_id carries payload.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-bool: an in-range bool is an index in the pin. True selects the event at index 1 when the session length is greater than one. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that success. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. False selects index 0. When that component is not the whole session the pin succeeds. When that component is the whole session the pin refuses with a different message. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal and does not claim that success.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-float: a float past the end and a negative float are rendered with repr in the pin. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal. An in-range float raises TypeError before the event is read. That TypeError is an extra vector and is not a whole pinned test. A zero float is in range and raises that same TypeError. It is not a rendered refusal. A float kind is not a checkpoint in the pin and the kept event is copied. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that success. A float id is a string id in the pin when the index is in range. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that success. A truthy float root_id is a string id in the pin. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that success.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-sweep: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications applies three recipes and checks loss. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. A successful amputate that also checks loss, plan, or canonical bytes is not covered by the event list alone. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_amputate_direct_apply_validation is four refusals of one function. The covered vector contains every refusal in that test.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-size: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_component_too_large checks planner blocked reason component-too-large. The published function does not plan. A direct refusal for a component larger than 10000 is not that test. The test events carry payload.

GAP-unresolvable-branch-amputate-root-id: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_amputate_resolves_index_from_root_id plans an int target_index and then applies. The published function does not plan. A params root_id success is not that test. The fixture events carry payload. A kept SessionEvent copies in the pin.
